protocol.family: log ROS = intercept + nonnegative wind coefficient * log1p(midflame km/h) + nonpositive moisture coefficient * dead moisture / 10
protocol.objective: equal-burn-day mean squared log error, intercept unpenalized
protocol.selection: inner leave-one-burn-day-out equal-day MAE; outer leave-one-burn-day-out evaluation
protocol.deploymentGuard: fuel 1 only; finite inputs inside training wind and moisture ranges; explicit experimental opt-in
protocol.limitations: Previously inspected single-site Australian data; nested resampling is retrospective internal evaluation, not new external validation. No post-evaluation family revision.

source.attribution: Gould, Jim; Gomes Da Cruz, Miguel; & Sullivan, Andrew (2023): 1986 Annaburroo Experimental Grassland Fire Data. v3. CSIRO. Data Collection. https://doi.org/10.25919/ycd3-w209

excluded.reason: Missing/invalid wind, moisture, observed ROS or unique day
